cpmplus.w3animtools.err.noAnimation: Select an animation first (Animations panel, in Animate mode).
cpmplus.w3animtools.err.selectPart: Select a part first (click it in the outliner).
cpmplus.w3animtools.err.noChannels: Tick at least one channel (Rotation, Position or Size).
cpmplus.w3animtools.warn.formulaSkipped: %s keyframe(s) with a formula (molang) were left as they were: formulas are never changed.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.reverse.desc: The whole animation plays backwards (every part, from 0 to the end)
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.reverse.empty: The animation "%s" has no keyframes to reverse.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.reverse.mixedSte: Some parts mix "step" keyframes with other ones: check that it looks the way you wanted.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.reverse.formula: %s keyframe(s) with a formula (molang) moved in time, but the formula stays the same.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.speed.desc: Makes the animation faster or slower. Keeps the same file size; untick "adjust snapping" for a lighter file
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.speed.hint: Tip: changing the speed keeps the same file size; untick "adjust snapping" for a lighter file.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.smooth.desc: Every keyframe of the selected animation becomes smooth (curve). Visibility stays a step
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.linear.desc: Every keyframe of the selected animation becomes straight (straight line between them). Visibility stays a step
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.smooth.nothing: Nothing changed: the animation was already smooth.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.linear.nothing: Nothing changed: the animation was already straight.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.onion.desc: Shows the pose before and after over the model, transparent, to help you animate
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.trail.desc: Shows a line with the path the selected part takes during the animation
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.trail_lock: Lock the trail on this part
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.trail_lock.desc: The trail keeps showing this part even when you select another one
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.mirror.desc: What you do on a part of one side is copied, mirrored, to the part on the other side (left/right, also in Portuguese)
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.missing: This Blockbench does not have this feature. Update Blockbench to use it.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f14.notNow: This is not available right now: open Animate mode and select an animation (and a part, when the feature needs one).
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.menu.desc: Makes the parts move more or less in the selected animation (0% to 300%)
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.title: Exaggerate or soften movement
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.intro: Changes how much the parts move in the animation "%s", without changing the timing.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.intro2: 100% = the same, 200% = moves twice as much, 50% = moves half as much, 0% = stays still in the normal pose. Colour and visibility do not change.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.onlySel.desc: Changes only the keyframes selected in the timeline
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.preview: Show on the model while adjusting
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.noSelectedKeys: No keyframe is selected in the timeline. Select the stretch or untick "Only the selected stretch".
cpmplus.w3animtools.f17.over360: Note: a rotation goes past 360 degrees (%s). It works, but check that this is what you want.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.menu.desc: Creates a keyframe on every animated part at the current time, keeping the pose shown now
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.title: Mark pose here
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.intro: Creates keyframes at %s on every part that already moves, with the pose shown now (the movement does not change). Good to "hold" the pose before changing another part.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.empty.desc: Also creates rotation, position and size keyframes on animated parts that do not use that channel yet
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.color.desc: Also marks the colour, only on parts with Recolor or coloured cubes that already change colour
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.outside: The timeline cursor is after the end of the animation. Move the cursor back inside the animation.
cpmplus.w3animtools.f23.nothing: Nothing to mark: the animated parts already have a keyframe at this time.
